youtube.title: The 3 Follow-Ups That Finish Any AI Draft
youtube.description:
What AI hands you first is a draft, not an answer. The people who get great results out of it don't write better first prompts - they send better second ones. These are the three follow-ups that fix most of what's wrong with a first draft, written out in full so you can paste them straight in.

0:00 A draft, not an answer
0:11 Follow-up one: cut it by 40%
0:24 Follow-up two: re-tone it
0:38 Follow-up three: challenge it
0:54 Say what's wrong, not "try again"

youtube.title: Write This Once, Paste It Into Every AI Prompt
youtube.description:
Ninety percent of "the AI doesn't get it" is missing context that never changes: your role, who reads your work, the words your company uses, and how you write. Put it in one block, paste it at the top of anything that matters, and every prompt after it gets better.

Includes the one rule that removes most invented facts.

youtube.description:

youtube.title: The One Line That Stops AI Inventing Numbers #shorts
youtube.description:
AI will invent a number and sound completely certain about it. Add this to your prompt: "Don't invent numbers, names or dates. If you need one, write [NEED: what] and I'll fill it in." Now it asks instead of guessing.
